notes.title: Dev Update 🌱 A New Game is Here!
notes.notes:
Dev Update 🌱 A New Game is Here!
Hello everyone, I’m the developer of Shanshui Haven.
First of all, thank you so much for all the support and feedback you’ve given to this game 🙏
Today I’d like to share some exciting news: my new game Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales is now live! 🎉

It’s a relaxing card-based farm merging game where you can:

🌱 Drag & merge cards to grow crops, raise animals, and cook delicious food

💰 Sell products or combine them into higher-value goods for greater profit

📦 Complete customer orders to unlock new crops, animals, and buildings

🌊 Face exciting “Order Wave” challenges with limited-time goals

🏡 Enjoy a cozy art style and easy-to-pick-up gameplay that’s both relaxing and rewarding

If you enjoyed the calm and cozy atmosphere of Shanshui Haven, you might also find this new game a fun experience.
Feel free to check it out and add it to your wishlist! 💖

👉 \[Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales]

notes.title: Full Version July 2025 Updates
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710367/e143eb653dc0ef2d2365195676707e3a41673864.png"]

Dear players,
This update focuses on building configuration, bug fixes, and performance tuning to further enhance the game’s rhythm and stability.

Update Highlights:

🔧 Building & Map Adjustments

Reconfigured layout for buildings such as the fishing village, wharf, and waterwheel

🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where an error would appear when card count was 0

Fixed a bug where newly unlocked towns were not displayed correctly

Resolved a problem where reloading a save after game over could still unlock a new town

🎆 Visual & Flow Improvements

Reduced the frequency of firework effects to avoid interrupting gameplay

Streamlined the feedback pace for card-based tasks to improve smoothness

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback! Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments — we’ll keep polishing the game to bring you an even better experience. Happy building!
[hr][/hr]
🎉 And by the way, check out our new game:
Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales Demo
A cozy, feel-good card-based farming game. Drag, merge, and fulfill orders to grow your very own bustling farm!

👉 Try it now – the free demo is live!

notes.title: Full Version Apr 2025 Updates
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44710367/3f3e769ad1002fedc76ac09a6512fa80284d314f.png

Dear Players,  
  
This update focuses on refining details and optimizing gameplay rhythm to bring you a smoother and more relaxing experience.

Update Highlights:  
  
 Harvesting Experience Improvements: Harvest display is now shown in a queue and adapts to game progression. New icons and effects provide a smoother and more natural experience.  
 Building & Map Adjustments: Improved building expansion logic and card drop rules for enhanced strategy and playability.  
 Seasons & VFX Optimization: Effects are now cleared before each level starts, and unnecessary weather VFX has been removed for a cleaner visual experience.  
 Building Configuration Tweaks: Adjustments made to ensure a more fluid overall experience.  
 Visual & Animation Enhancements: Added outlines to static images, along with score animations and number pop effects for more impactful feedback.  


Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments — we’ll keep working hard to bring you an even better experience. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Shanshui Haven Full Version is Now Live
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44710367/9667902745d4ab17b3bdc49b45e277c48dd97fae.png

Dear Players,

I am thrilled to announce that the full version of Shanshui Haven is officially released today! I sincerely thank all the players for their support and feedback during the Early Access phase. I've worked hard to refine the game to an ideal state, and I hope everyone can enjoy the relaxation and fun this game offers amidst their busy schedules.

Changes from the previous version:

 Added more building shapes: Enhances the fun and challenge of the game.
 Adjusted some visual effects: Makes the game more visually appealing.
 Optimized the values of special function cards: Balances the game better.
 Adjusted the drop rates and scores of rare buildings: Adds strategic depth to the game.


Future Plans:

 New game project: After a short break, I will start a new game project. Stay tuned for updates.
 Continuous updates for Shanshui Haven: Although the update frequency will decrease, I will continue to update Shanshui Haven. If you have any interesting ideas and suggestions, please leave them in the comments. I will see them. For changes that do not affect the overall game structure, I will consider adding them in future updates.


Thank You:

Once again, thank you to all the players who participated in the Early Access testing and to the hundreds of players who purchased the game during the Early Access phase. Your support and encouragement have motivated me to continually improve and officially release this game. Wishing everyone a happy life!

notes.title: Latest Game Update: Enhancing Diversity and Balance
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44710367/b9d5c009564ac027d69f6c2dbcd1e907139bb000.png

Dear Players,

Our latest update aims to enhance the diversity and balance of the game. Below are the key adjustments and their benefits:

New Features and Adjustments:

 Architectural Diversity: Ensuring that when buildings are drawn, the same type can appear in random shapes, adding to the playability and visual diversity of the game.
 Adjustment of Fishery and Fishing Village Order: By adjusting the order of fisheries and fishing villages, we have balanced the progression and challenge of the game, making the player experience smoother.
 Building Unlock Mechanism: Buildings only enter the candidate list when they are unlocked, ensuring that players gradually unlock new content throughout the game, maintaining freshness and challenge.
 Building Placement Rewards: Throughout the game, opportunities to choose buildings will arise, encouraging players to plan their building layouts more strategically, while also increasing the game's interactivity and choice.
 Season Configuration Update: Updating the season configuration and fixing missing brick issues enriches the game environment and enhances the player's immersion and gaming experience.



 These adjustments not only increase the strategic and diverse nature of the game but also enhance its playability and fun. By introducing more random elements and choices, players can enjoy a more personalized and rich gaming experience.


Please note these updates for a better gaming experience! Thank you for your support!
